CPS_Global_q0: Cells from a human brain with the lowest overall cortical pathology burden: minimal amyloid and tau pathology, preserved neuronal integrity and quiescent glia.
CPS_Global_q1: Cells from a human brain with low-to-moderate overall cortical pathology burden: early amyloid and tau accumulation with mild glial activation.
CPS_Global_q2: Cells from a human brain with moderate-to-high overall cortical pathology burden: substantial amyloid and tau pathology, activated microglia and reactive astrocytes.
CPS_Global_q3: Cells from a human brain with the highest overall cortical pathology burden: severe amyloid and tau pathology, neuronal loss, gliosis and neuroinflammation.
CPS_Local_q0: Cells from a brain region with the lowest local pathology burden: minimal regional amyloid and tau pathology.
CPS_Local_q1: Cells from a brain region with low-to-moderate local pathology burden.
CPS_Local_q2: Cells from a brain region with moderate-to-high local pathology burden.
CPS_Local_q3: Cells from a brain region with the highest local pathology burden: severe regional amyloid and tau pathology with gliosis.
nan: Cells from a human brain with uncharacterized neuropathology.
